decision: Reject archived definition candidate; production retrieval unchanged. All four preregistered component gates failed.

corpus.note: Full corpus is not bundled; retrieved, anchor and reviewer source files and hashes are preserved. HEAD is provenance, not a clean-worktree assertion.

protocol.hypothesis: Separate source retrieval units from tool routing by replaying every recorded find_evidence query, then answer from fixed source-only contexts with no tools.

queries.selection: All distinct find_evidence inputs from the previous 36 runs; no favorable-case selection.

methods.locator_hints: Frozen current find_evidence; materialize only its supplied first-five read_lines hints, merge overlapping ranges, preserve first-hit order, greedily include whole merged spans under the common budget. This is a deterministic replay adapter, not the full production agent.
methods.definitions: Archived find_evidence_context at budget_tokens=1800, then render its returned source spans in the same source-only format. No reranking or post-result tuning.

context.format: Identical source-excerpt disclaimer and file:start-end citations for both methods; source bytes preserved. No selection diagnostics, labels, scores, query metadata or oracle anchors shown to Qwen.
context.budget_note: Same ceiling, not identical token consumption. The definition method also spends its original budget on its native metadata before normalization; unused budget is not topped up.

model.name: qwen/qwen3.5-9b
model.sampling_seed_rule: base+rep-1, shared across all cases and methods
model.retry_policy: No automatic retries; retain failed and truncated answers.

protocol.coverage: Exact delivered-line coverage of independently frozen source anchors; complete criterion requires every anchor. This is a narrow reference-coverage diagnostic, not semantic correctness.
protocol.quality: Reuse five-criterion 0/0.5/1 causal scoring and material false claims; failed generations score zero. Grade answers against source, with method labels and token costs hidden.
protocol.analysis: Primary comparison uses all 13 recorded-scope queries, macro-averaged equally over the four questions. Three scope ablations are reported separately, never pooled to inflate the primary result. Seeds are paired; no best-of selection.
decision_rule: A component follow-on requires at least +0.10 absolute macro-average anchor-line coverage, strictly better macro causal score, no lower causal score on any question, and no more answers with material false claims.
Even a positive fixed-context result cannot promote production behavior; routing and free-agent end-to-end behavior remain untested.
known_limitations: Questions and queries are reused, not unseen generalization tasks.
The locator-hint adapter is not an optimal reader or the full select_context tool.
Canonical source anchors can miss equivalent evidence; assess semantic answers separately.
This is a one-shot fixed-context study, not cumulative agent trajectory token savings.

methods.locator_hints: Frozen control find_evidence; materialize first-five read hints, merge overlaps, greedily retain whole hinted spans under the common ceiling. Not the full production agent or select_context.
methods.definitions: Archived find_evidence_context under 1800 native response tokens, then normalize selected source spans. Native metadata already consumes some of this ceiling; no top-up.

rendering: Same source-only path/range/text format and 1800 cl100k_base token ceiling, not equal consumed tokens. Queries, arm labels, rankings and anchors are not supplied to Qwen.

coverage.meaning: Fraction of frozen canonical source lines supplied, averaged over five criteria then equally over four questions; not semantic accuracy.
coverage.scope_ablation: All three scoped/workspace pairs have zero canonical anchor-line coverage in both methods.

quality_method: Four question-specific label/cost-blinded model reviewers checked actual source before context support. Scores are subjective causal-criterion judgments, not accuracy probabilities or independent human validation. Raw reviews and two contradiction-rule score adjudications are preserved.

diagnosis.evidence: For Q12_workspace, both methods reach stack.rs but query terms exit/status/last_exit match none of the actual LAST_EXIT_CODE, set_last_exit_code, external_exit_code or exit_code lines with the current whole-word matcher. An illustrative underscore-boundary diagnostic matches those lines.
diagnosis.limit: Diagnostic only; no modified retrieval algorithm was run or promoted. Wider scopes still do not deliver set_last_error.

diagnosis.finding: Relevant definitions starved by earlier bodies
diagnosis.evidence: Q10 includes eval.rs among locator hits and in candidate output, but the candidate selects its small helpers rather than eval_call. Earlier MessagePack bodies consume 1250 source tokens; eval_call alone is 1232. The policy does not shorten a definition that fits alone merely to fit the remaining budget.
diagnosis.limit: This establishes the observed packing obstacle, not a claim that one ranking patch would solve end-to-end routing.

diagnosis.evidence: Workspace ablations sometimes move stack.rs to ranks 1-2, but still miss the setter and precedence branches. Q12 definitions gains only 0.25/5 mean partial credit; Q13 widening loses its callsite-only 1/5 and removes two false claims.
diagnosis.limit: Ablations remain separate from the recorded-query main comparison.

limitations: Four reused questions on one Rust repository; recorded queries are correlated, not independent task samples.
Two requested decoding seeds do not guarantee deterministic GPU execution. One identical prompt/seed pair produced different answers; all duplicates were retained.
Canonical line anchors can miss equivalent or callsite evidence; semantic grades are reported separately.
Equal ceiling is not equal supplied context: recorded-query means are 651.23 versus 1730.54 cl100k_base tokens.
No native-tool arm, tool routing or free-agent search; no end-to-end token-saving claim in this experiment.
No answer met all five causal criteria. Completed one-shot text, including partial abstention, is not a correct answer.
No post-result tuning, retries or best-of selection. Source snapshots and preregistered inputs remained unchanged.
next_target: Test identifier-aware evidence matching and relevance/budget allocation before returning larger bodies; retain these frozen queries for regression measurement. Any improved component still needs separate free-agent verification.

replay.extract_into: Directory containing the experiment scripts, preserving control/, candidate/ and shared_harness/.
replay.requirements: Python 3.12 and archived project dependencies; original full corpus for retrieval; local Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M loaded at 32768 with flash attention. For answer-only replay, use preserved locator_hints.json and definitions.json instead of *_replay.json.
